name: Handover
summary: A builder's site with the calm of the finished house. Limewash ground, the photographs carry the colour. One hero idea: a real photograph of a finished garden wing that becomes a 3D extension on your own kind of house when you tap it, with its size worked out. The site code under it (a key tag) opens this week on site. How a build runs is a section through a house: the finished room above a duck-egg ground line, the work below it. Castoro, with one word in italic, against Kumbh Sans. Duck egg only as a fill; its shadow for links. Nothing moves with the scroll.
